batting.name: CL White
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b WD Parnell

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b Ankit Sharma

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c CL White b S Dhawan

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c DJ Harris b A Ashish Reddy

batting.name: M Manhas
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b V Pratap Singh

balls.text: Duminy slogs a short of a length ball towards long-on where Smith comes sprinting in but drops the catch, it was hit flat and the ball was dying on him, Parnell gave only six in the final over
full ball outside off stump, the batsman reaches for it and steers to third man
mis-timed once again towards the off side, Duminy had made room by moving towards leg
length ball outside off stump, mis-timed towards long off
Parnell delivers a yorker which Duminy forces out towards midwicket
White's holed out to long-off, he swung hard at a good length ball outside off stump and sliced it high in the air to Steve Smith

bowled him, Sanga goes after a terrific innings. Nehra bowled it in the blockhole just outside off, Sanga got down low to squeeze the ball out on the off side but got an edge on to his stumps. He was slow to start with but Sanga accelerated superbly
that's over the backward square leg boundary, and it's a no-ball for height. Nehra delivered a full toss and Sanga pulled it from around leg stump
long-on has no chance! Sanga steps out of his crease and drills a length ball past the bowler, along the ground with impeccable timing
Sanga steps out and towards the off side to pick up a full toss off his pads and flick it over the backward square leg boundary

Sanga makes room and hits the ball flat over cover, Samuels runs to his left from sweeper and dives, he taps the ball into play but his feet are close to the line as he taps the ball again to keep it from going over the boundary
a full toss and Sanga hits it hard past the bowler, Smith runs to his right from long-on to field
Sanga stays in his crease to a slower ball on a length and swats it through midwicket to add to the glut of boundaries
full ball on the pads, White clips it off his pads to the fine leg boundary
the slower ball has disappeared. It was on a length and White got under it and launched it into orbit over the square leg boundary
White goes down on one knee to slog sweep the ball far over the square leg boundary, hit with immense power
he's laid into that and smashed the ball into the stands beyond deep midwicket, it was a length ball and White swung extremely hard
White backs away to try and smash a slow ball from outside off, ends up slicing it over the infield at cover point, not timed well
Sangakkara moves a long way outside of to try and scoop over short fine leg, the slow loopy full toss beats him and goes off the pads again
another slower ball outside off, White swings too hard and too early and is beaten
Sanga tries to pull too hard and gets hit on the thigh by a slower ball at 107 kph
full toss, driven towards long on for a single, White brings up his fifty
now he tries to reverse paddle but gets beaten, the slower ball bounces over off stump and hits Uthappa's pads. Sanga tried to hit that with the back of his bat
what's happened there? Sanga moved outside the off stump to try and chip the ball over short fine leg, he missed but the full toss hit his pad and shot between Uthappa's legs to the boundary
full toss on middle stump, White flicks off the front foot to Samuels at deep square to bring up the 100 partnership, in pretty good time
White nudges a length ball off his pads towards short fine leg
backs away once again and swats the short of a length ball towards midwicket where Kartik runs to his left and dives to field
backs away towards the leg side and mis-times the pull to midwicket
phew, length ball outside off stump, Sangakkara strides forward and drives the ball with power through cover and into the gap on the boundary
shot! Sanga steps out of his crease, and then chips the ball over the fielder at short fine leg, he adjusted well to the length of the ball, that's his fifty
Sanga comes out and taps the good length ball through square leg, the ball is hit gently enough to allow the batsman to run the second before Samuels can get to it
the quicker ball outside off stump, Sangakkara tries to drive but gets an inside edge past off stump
Sangakkara's steaming along now, he gets down on one knee and slog sweeps the ball over short fine leg
Sangakkara gets down low and lofts the ball hard and flat over Samuels' head, the bowler got a finger on it, the fielder at long-off sprinted and dived full length but could not prevent the boundary
makes room again but Samuels follows him, worked off the pads through midwicket, Deccan go past 100 and look set for a very decent total
Sanga backed away towards leg again to cut but got a thick outside edge to the third man boundary
precise placement and adequate timing, Sangakkara made room by moving outside leg stump and lofted the full ball over extra cover
in the blockhole, Sangakkara digs it out through cover
full ball on the pads, clipped firmly to Parnell on the square leg boundary
width outside off stump, hittable length too, but Sangakkara mis-times the drive on this sluggish pitch
good length on middle and off, White drives to long-off
Sangakkara steps out of his crease and drives a length ball on the up through extra cover
good length angling across the right-hander, White pushes from his crease towards the off side
there was width outside off stump and Sangakkara has used it well, waiting late before cutting past the keeper and fine of the fielder at short third man
worked off the pads in front of square leg
slogged towards long off for a single

Sangakkara drives firmly towards long-on where Steven Smith sprints and dives to his right to cut off the boundary, he throws the ball while sliding to the fielder running from long-off, Manish Pandey, who throws it back to the bowler
White makes room but then has to wait a while until Ganguly's gentle pace reaches him, hit off the back foot through cover
length ball on off stump, Sanga leans forward and drives past the bowler towards long-off
White stays in his crease and nudges the ball through midwicket
White steps out, picks up the short length early, and pulls the ball into the gap on the midwicket boundary. The 50 partnership is up, not in very good time
Sanga charges and slogs, inside-edging a short of a length ball from outside off stump on to his leg
White comes out of his crease and whips a length ball off his pads behind square leg
White comes out of his crease again and opens the face to steer a low ball behind point
White walks out and clubs the short of a length ball with a flat bat towards long-on
makes room by moving towards leg and plays towards cover
Sanga works the ball off his pads, Ganguly is giving the batsmen no room at all
now he backs away towards leg but Ganguly follows him, played in front of square leg
White made a movement towards leg and then came back to his normal position, Ganguly kept the ball on a good length on middle stump, White defended
good length on middle and off, Sangakkara punches towards long-off
good length and straight, driven to long-on for a single
played off the front foot through midwicket
played towards fine leg for a single
played behind square leg a single

the first six of the innings, White comes out of his crease, gets under the length of the ball and lofts it dead straight over the straight boundary, Smith jumped on the boundary to try and tap the ball into play but was unsuccessful
White leans forward and tries to nudge on the leg side but doesn't make proper contact
Sangakkara steps out, Kartik shortens his length and Sanga can only work the ball in front of square
Sangakkara moves forward and across to work the ball off his pads
good length and straight, White drives past the bowler
short ball once again, skidding through, Sangakkara mis-times the pull behind square
short of a length but the ball doesn't bounce as much as White thought it would, it skidded through, White had to hurry through his pull shot
Sangakkara walks across his stumps and mis-times the glance close behind square, Uthappa has to field
length ball on the pads, White moves forward and flicks behind square
short ball and Sanga hits it to the fine leg boundary by swiveling and pulling
Clarke makes his first real play of the game, moving to his left at midwicket and intercepting a Sanga slog sweep
White presses forward and plays the ball off his pads through midwicket
Sanga steps out again and pushes towards long-off
Sangakkara steps out and plays back to the bowler, Kartik dives to his left and parries the ball towards midwicket
wicket to wicket line, Sangakkara stays back and defends
played off the front foot towards Smith at backward point
Sangakkara takes two steps forward and pulls a short of a length ball through midwicket
fuller ball angling across the left hander, Sangakkara pokes outside off and gets an inside edge into the ground towards the keeper, that kept a bit low
short ball outside off, doesn't bounce much, White swivels and pulls along the ground to the square leg boundary
Sangakkara came forward and dropped the ball close on the off side
played off the pads on the leg side

That's down leg side and the batsman must have got some bat on that, the umpire's given it runs. Uthappa moved to his left and couldn't stop the boundary. That will go down as a dropped catch, it carried to the keeper. Simple chance, too
short of a length angling into the left-hander, Sangakkara works the ball off his body towards midwicket
Sangakkara missed out there, the length was short, the line outside off, he cut the ball firmly but did not beat point
first runs off Parnell today, Sangakkara steers the length ball from outside off towards wide third man
now it's eight dots, Sangakkara tries to cut but is beaten by a good length ball outside off
good length on off stump, Sangakkara presses forward and punches to mid-off, that's Parnell's seventh dot ball
played off the pads behind square
Sangakkara moves across his stumps and glances the ball off his pads to short fine leg
middle stump has taken a battering! Dhawan attempted to hoick across the line, the ball was on a good length and a wicket-to-wicket line, Dhawan missed and his middle stump was uprooted
on White's pads this time but once again the batsman does not beat short fine leg with the flick, that's two loose balls the bowler's got away with
fuller ball on the pads, Dhawan whips but doesn't connect properly and can't beat short fine leg
good length on leg and middle, Dhawan defends from his crease and Kumar moves to his left to field
good length on leg and middle, driven from the crease towards mid-on
White moves forward and drives a full ball towards point
good length on off and middle, Dhawan pushes towards mid-on and runs
a full ball hits White on the pad after he misses the flick, Nehra appeals but that pitched outside leg stump
Nehra slants the ball across the right-hander and gives White lots of width, the batsman moves forward and thumps the ball through cover, Nehra grimaces
played from the crease through midwicket with the angle into the left-hander
pushed towards midwicket off the back foot
this time he successfully goes inside out over cover, coming down the track and making good contact
Shawan goes back to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce outside off stump
Dhawan charges and moves towards leg to drive inside out over cover, he got a thick outside edge between slip and backward point to the third man boundary
pushed off the front foot towards cover
White plays the ball with the turn into him towards long-on
yes he does, that's the 14th maiden of the tournament, the last ball is played from the crease to point
short of a length with width outside off stump, Dhawan cuts but is beaten
good length on off and middle stump, defended back to the bowler
a full ball with some swing back into the left-hander, Dhawan drives back to the bowler
Dhawan tries to drive from his crease and gets an inside edge on to the pad
a full toss angling into the left-hander, defended on the leg side
played off the back foot through cover
punched from the crease towards cover
pushed towards long-on for a single, where Smith fields
the quick ball outside off stump, White moves forward and blocks
White clips the ball off his pads through midwicket

he's gone first ball! Samuels pitched the ball outside off stump and turned it away from the left-hander just a little, Patel went after it and tried to play a big drive, the ball went off the inside edge and clipped off stump
Samuels heaves the final ball to long-on, Pune fall 13 short
Sangakkara comes running in from extra cover and dives forward to catch a flat hit, Manhas was aiming for down the ground but ended up slicing the short of a length ball
Smith slogs across the line towards deep midwicket and sprints for one, he wants the second but Manhas sends him back, Smith wanted the strike
a full ball outside off, Manhas aims for down the ground but gets an outside edge to third man
he's carted that high and far over deep square leg, moving across his stumps to heave a length ball with a lot of power
the first ball is terrific and in the blockhole outside off, Mahnas gets beaten
or perhaps the game's still open, Smith's blasted the last ball of the penultimate over, another slower one, over the straight boundary

caught at deep midwicket! That's probably the game. Uthappa heaved a slower ball delivered from the back of the hand towards deep midwicket, where Harris, who is on the field for Duminy, leaned forward and caught the ball just before it hit the ground
another slower ball outside off, driven with power towards wide long-off, where White runs to his left and dives to save the boundary
length ball outside off stump, Uthappa moves forward and frees his arms, hitting the ball through the line over long-off, about time too, Pune fans will think
Uthappa comes out but can only mis-time the slower ball through midwicket
the slower ball outside off stump, Smith reaches for it and drives to deep cover
a full toss outside off stump, Uthappa gets beaten
full toss outside off stump, Smith cuts over the infield and Dhawan fumbles on the boundary, Trevor Penney, Deccan's fielding coach, has a chuckle
full ball on the pads, Smith flicks to the fielder at deep backward square leg where the fielder fields awkwardly
length ball around off stump, Smith slogs across the line and hits towards wide long-on
good length ball outside off, Uthappa flat-bats it towards extra cover and runs
a full toss around off stump, Smith moves across and drives through midwicket
now that's a high full toss, above waist for sure, Smith moves across and plays the ball fine past the keeper and to the fine leg boundary
Smith steps out and hits a slower wide ball to the fielder on the sweeper boundary
Uthappa moves forward and across to slog towards deep midwicket, he mis-times it but the ball falls short of Harris running in from the boundary
missed timed drive on the off side

dropped at deep square leg, but it's a no-ball, for height? A full toss and Uthappa pulls it flat and  to Ankit Sharma, he had to move a little to his right. I'm sorry but that isn't above waist height, a poor call from the umpire
driven past the bowler, Dhawan fields from long on

Smith moves into position to play a reverse hit, the bowler follows batsman and pitches in the blockhole outside leg stump (for the right-hander). Smith eventually dug it out like a left-hander past the bowler
the slower ball on off stump, Smith mis-times the pull in front of square and they run two before Harris can run in and prevent it
in the blockhole outside off, driven towards cover point
short ball and Smith pulls with power behind square, the ball races to the boundary
nudged off the pads through square leg
good length with movement away from the right hander, Uthappa sways and lets it go, the asking rate is only 15 per over
length outside off, Smith opens the face and steers to third man
Smith slogs across the line against a length ball around off and hits it through square leg
Uthappa comes out and isn't to the pitch of the ball, he works it off the pads through midwicket
driven back to the bowler on the front foot, the bowler fumbles but chases after the ball to prevent the single
Smith comes out but is yorked, he digs it out on the leg side
wide outside off stump, flatter ball, Smith tries to cut but is beaten
nudged off the front foot through midwicket, they run two because the ball is hit slowly to the fielder in the deep
Robin moves forward and lofts the ball flat towards long-off, falls well short of the fielder
Smith moves forward and looks to play on the leg but ends up pushing the leg break back to Mishra, who throws the ball back to the keeper
pushed off the front foot towards deep cover
played off the front foot through midwicket
tossed up on middle stump, Smith gets under the ball and hoists it over the cow corner boundary, it just cleared the rope
driven on the front foot towards long-on, quick running
Smith stays back to a tossed up leg break and plays it late, towards the off side, not very fluently
played off the pads to square leg
shocking fielding, shocking. Uthappa plays the reverse sweep and Veer Pratap lets it go through his legs at short fine leg

caught at cover! Both set batsmen are gone and Ganguly swings his bat in disgust. Ganguly made room to the ball that angles into him from round the wicket and drives it flat and straight to White. Ganguly tosses his bat and gloves away as he crosses the boundary
defended from the crease on the off side
driven on the front foot to long off
Smith moves forward and whips the ball with power through midwicket, beating the fielder on the boundary
played to long on for a single
played back to the bowler

Dhawan's dropped a sitter, Lehmann will be fuming, but hang on, I think there's a run out. Clarke's gone, while coming back for the second. Clarke tried to flick on the leg side but got a leading edge that went high in the air towards point, Dhawan was under the ball but didn't get into a good position. Mishra was alert enough to pick up the ball after the drop and fire the throw to Parthiv, who broke the stumps with Clarke just short of completing the second
Clarke picks his gap on the cow corner boundary and pulls the ball from outside off stump into it
Ganguly steps out and backs away again, he smashes the ball hard and straight at the bowler, who barely had time to get his hands up before the ball thudded into him and went on the off side
Ganguly steps out, makes room by moving towards leg, and lofts a length ball flat over extra cover. Pune need more of this and quick
that's wide outside off stump, Clarke reaches out to cut but is beaten, it was the slower one delivered from the back of the hand
Ganguly clears his front foot and heaves, mis-times along the ground through square
short of a length outside off stump, cut hard off the back foot to the fielder on the sweeper boundary
cut off the back foot through point
driven on the front foot through cover, they went to the third umpire for some reason to check if Ganguly was home safe, he was, easily
driven on the front foot to cover
Clarke tries to slog sweep and is beaten

Clarke steps out and then dabs the legbreak to point, Clarke wants the single and Ganguly responds, both batsmen reach about half-way before Ganguly decides he does not want to continue to the danger end, Clarke turns around and begins to run back, the throw from Duminy at point was poor, in front of the stumps, Parthiv collected and flicked the ball back without looking at the stumps and missed, Clarke was miles out
short ball, and Ganguly pulls along the ground to deep square leg
the googly, Ganguly stays back and dabs on the off side
too full and Ganguly makes room and drills the ball past the bowler, bisecting the gap between long on and long off
Clarke gets down on one knee and slog sweeps behind square
Ganguly makes room by moving towards leg and lofts Duminy over the head of the fielder at long-off
Clarke gets down on one knee and sweeps behind square
cut of fthe back foot in front of point
an appeal for lbw after Ganguly moves forward and defends, that was good shout, very close, it hit the pad in line and was going straight through

Clarke steps out and drives the ball hard and straight back at Duminy, he sticks out his left hand and gets hit, there's blood on his little finger after the ball deflects off it and goes to long-off. He's getting some treatment from the physio. Aleem Dar was dancing out of the way before the ball was diverted
Ganguly charges to hit down the ground but gets an inside edge behind square
that's extremely wide outside off stump
bowled flat and straight at Ganguly's pads, he works it behind square
worked off the back foot through midwicket
the flatter ball but a bit short, Ganguly goes back and hits towards long-on
defended on the front foot towards the bowler

Mishra beats Ganguly with the one that slides past the left-hander, Ganguly was lunging forward to push straight, Parthiv whipped off the bails but the back foot was grounded just in time, I think. the TV umpire says not out
bowled on a good length and straight, Clarke stays in his crease and plays on the leg side
Clarke steps out and works the ball off his pads towards short fine leg
driven to long-off for a single
Ganguly moves forward and outside off to paddle towards square but misses, he's hit on the pad outside off
another one drifts down leg side
flicked off the pads through midwicket
huge appeal for lbw after Clarke goes back to work the ball square and gets hit on the pad, that pitched outside leg, only just
his second ball from round the wicket drifts down leg side was well, this time Ganguly sweeps but can't beat Mishra at short fine leg
his first ball from round the wicket drifts down leg side
short and wide outside off stump, rubbish from Steyn, Clarke cuts hard and Reddy doesn't bother with it this time, the ball raced to the backward point boundary

now a length ball with width outside off stump, Clarke stays in his crease and cuts behind point, Reddy sprints to his right from third man and dives full length, he taps the ball into play but then watches it roll away from him and into the boundary
length ball on middle and leg, Clarke moves forward and lifts the ball off his pads over square leg, Steyn's been flat today
played from the crease towards point
good length from round the wicket, Ganguly stays in his crease and pushes towards point
Ganguly makes room and drives a length ball off the back foot flat over cover, superbly hit
Ganguly backs away and drives a full ball towards mid-on, this over has boosted the asking-rate
driven to mid-on

Ganguly is caught on the crease and gets an inside edge on to the pad, the ball goes towards point and Clarke set off for a single and ran a long way down, Ganguly did not move, Clarke had to hurry back. Ganguly was looking to see if the umpire was giving him out lbw because the bowler had appealed
Clarke moves across his stumps to work the ball on the leg side but misses and is hit on the pad, Deccan appeal for an lbw but Aleem Dar says not out, Carke was forward as well
Clarke moves forward and plays a flowing square drive, but can't beat the fielder at point
Clarke moves forward and drives a full ball to mid-off
defended on the off side
vintage Ganguly, moves forward and pushes a length ball through a packed off side and to the cover boundary, merely pushed it with impeccable timing
Ganguly clears his front foot and swats a short ball between mid-on and midwicket to the wide long-on boundary
Ganguly sits on the back foot and opens the face to steer the ball towards backward point, that was 139 kph
Ganguly stayed in his crease again and drove to cover
good length outside off, played from the crease towards cover
length ball outside off, Clarke drives off the front foot to point, he'll feel he missed out on an opportunity
good length and straight, defended from the crease to the bowler
Clarke moves forward and drives a length ball on the up through cover point, the outfield is quick
too short, and Clarke swats it over midwicket, but there's a fielder in the deep
short of a length outside off, Clarke mis-times a drive to cover
Clarke tries to cut a short of a length ball from outside off stump but gets a bottom edge past his stumps to the fine leg boundary
Ganguly moves across this time and works the ball off his pads behind square
Ganguly backs away far outside leg stump to try and cut, the bowler follows him and nearly hits leg stump
nudged off the pads through midwicket
Clarke moves forward and across to drill the ball through midwicket with a powerful shot along the ground
Ganguly steps out, isn't to the pitch of the ball and drives to long-off
Ganguly moves forward and defends
Clarke defends on the front foot
dropped at square leg! Ganguly comes forward, gets down on one knee and sweeps the ball in the air, Reddy moves to his left but cannot hold on
Clarke steps out of his crease and pushes the ball gently to mid-on
Ganguly leans across and drives a full ball towards long on
Ganguly moves forward and across to nudge on the leg side but is hit on the pad, that was turning past leg stump
another first-ball wicket! Pandey hits the ball flat towards mid-on, where Sanga moves to his left and takes the catch. Parthiv Patel was out first ball in Chargers' innings, and now Pandey goes.
